slides.headline: Lore beat slop
slides.aside: the word of the year is lore
slides.body: Sprout Social named “lore” its 2026 social media word of the year, with over 10 million mentions. “Slop” had 8.8 million. 57% of social users say they want original, multi-part series from brands.
slides.take: [YOUR TAKE: one or two lines in your words]

slides.headline: America's No. 1 film is a documentary

media.label: You Can See Everything · A24 via AP

slides.body: You Can See Everything, Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's film on Elizabeth Holmes, took $10.6M over Halloween weekend to top the box office. Rotten Tomatoes says no non-concert documentary has been No. 1 since Fahrenheit 9/11 in 2004.

slides.headline: Your melody goes in first
slides.body: Drop a MIDI sketch into Suno and it builds the full song around your notes. The prompt decides whether it follows them exactly, develops the motif or plays it on new instruments. Pro and Premier only for now.

slides.headline: Stranger Things ended.
slides.body: On the night Will vanished in the show, Netflix announced Other Worlds, a live-action series set in the 1950s for 2028, plus a blooper reel and an Upside Down Tamagotchi.

slides.headline: Stems on your own laptop
slides.body: Photon splits a mixed track into stems, separates up to six speakers from one file and cleans up noisy location audio. It runs on your own machine, nothing uploaded. $259 on launch sale.

slides.headline: Fanta stopped renting monsters
slides.body: After years of licensing Chucky, Michael Myers and Freddy Fazbear, Fanta launched four original monsters in 50 markets. Its global VP of marketing: “Halloween should be to Fanta what Christmas is to Coke.”

slides.headline: Clips that come with their own stems
slides.body: Up to 15-second clips with synced stereo sound, finished up to 4K. The soundtrack can be split into dialogue, music and effects, so you can drop in your own track. Creator subscribers get 15 free a day until 15 Nov.

slides.headline: The No. 1 costume was a horror mascot
slides.body: Google's top trending Halloween costume came from Casper Kelly's horror film Buddy, and searches for it passed “kids unicorn costume” for the first time. Four of the top five are characters.

slides.headline: A YouTuber made a $371M hit
slides.aside: then gave his next film away
slides.body: Curry Barker's Obsession made $371M worldwide on a budget of about $750K, per GamesRadar. On 29 Oct he premiered his next horror short, Mama Bear, free on his YouTube channel.

slides.headline: Build your own creative app
slides.body: Runway App Studio turns a plain description into a working app you can share with your team or a public link. Runway's own examples: a character swap app and an app that makes instrumental albums with cover art.

slides.headline: Worlds you can play
slides.body: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 makes playable, real-time worlds you steer with text, with live sound, music and dialogue. It's with trusted testers for now.

slides.headline: Steal the animated story short
slides.body: Its proof is a 67-second short about the 1831 Broughton bridge. The same move works for any history story people love, without filming or archival footage.
